fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 detects the exchange but cannot clear the current soundness gate. For four centered one-hot marks, legal mark energy is 3/4 while e_i±Δ has energy 11/4 or 27/4, so both attack ratios are at most 9<17; weighting these marks with the existing sub-17 attack coordinates cannot exceed 17, and zero has cheaper mark energy 1/4.

Proposal 2 proves only the elementary kernel formula for an already-given Lawrence matrix; it supplies no compiler matrix or marked factorization and therefore does not discriminate L1. Arbitrary unimodular row transport also preserves Euclidean energies only with an explicitly realized pulled-back metric, which is not supplied.

Proposal 3 cannot infer a universal obstruction from circuits or SNF data for one unspecified fanout serialization. Auxiliary contraction may erase the distinguishing circuit, matching invariants is not sufficient for Lawrence equivalence, and no complete candidate matrix or universal impossibility argument is given.

Proposal 4 identifies ordinary cellular H1 with seam soundness without justification. It does not control the G13 honest-affine collision, physical flips, DROP, integer Graver moves, common energy, or marked higher-Lawrence equivalence; a local homology computation therefore misses the frontier gates.

Proposal 5 immediately inherits the integral C2 group-ring relation (1-g)(1+g)=0 and supplies no rows proven to block its augmentation kernel. Its two-switch experiment is another local proxy and also does not implement or verify target-only routing in the complete compiler.

Proposal 6 is conditional on an arithmetic-matroid refutation that has not been established. Normality and finite Graver data for one diamond cannot imply the F2 uniform signed-Graver bound under repeated gluing, which is exactly the roadmap obstruction.

Proposal 7 searches an arbitrary bounded box rather than the required complete brick and omits the COPY tree, three-COPY cycle, occurrence expansion, full transfer/anchor data, and exact depth-1/2/3 serialization. UNSAT for that box would not move L1, while finite attack cuts cannot justify the claim that all unrestricted kernel and Graver obstructions are encoded.
evidence: The verified 54x76 brick contains the conformally primitive Δ=h000-h011-h100+h111 and embeds malformed zero-residual states of energy 92 or 108 against legal energy 76 in all 384 tested fibers. This finite evidence kills that serialization and supplies the mandatory exchange pre-gate for mutations.
The separate verified 136x142 serialization has common legal energy 142 but all-zero DROP energy 692<17·142. Residual rescaling cannot repair exact-kernel witnesses.

ROADMAP requires one actual full marked brick containing NAND, both COPY orientations, fanout diamond, three-COPY cycle, physical/pair/DROP/transfer/anchor rows, followed by exact depth-1/2/3 kernel identities and compatibility audits. None of the seven proposals supplies that serialization.

The Lean verifier proves only that integral square Gram isometries are signed permutations. It does not validate arbitrary marked equivalence, metric transport, a Lawrence compiler, primitive classification, or soundness.

Earlier equal-radius evidence is finite only: G31 passed one shell, while G32 and G37 exhibited additive parity with no strict composition growth. It cannot support Proposal 1's implied scalable escape.
next_experiment: No implementation is authorized for these proposals. A genuinely changed mutation may re-enter only by freezing the complete ROADMAP brick and first proving, for every honest fiber, that both signs of every honest-affine exchange are legal or every malformed sign has energy strictly above 17E, with DROP also above threshold; only then serialize depths 1–3 and test exact marked Lawrence identities and complete Graver data.
